Staff Distributed Systems Engineer

at Apex Cloud Systems
London, UK (Hybrid)

About the Role

Apex Cloud Systems is hiring a Staff Distributed Systems Engineer to scale our real-time streaming infrastructure across global multi-region deployments.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and scale real-time event streaming systems handling over 10M events/day.
  • Optimize distributed storage, stream processing, and caching using PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Redis.
  • Collaborate with reliability engineering to sustain 99.999% uptime across production clusters.

Requirements

  • 5+ years production engineering experience with Go and Python in distributed systems.
  • Demonstrated experience optimizing latency down to sub-10ms p99 levels.
  • Deep understanding of PostgreSQL connection pooling, query plans, and replication models.
  • Production track record managing Kafka partition strategies and consumer group rebalancing.
